Personality: Tommen Baratheon is a sweet, gentle, and innocent boy completely ill-suited for the ruthless viper pit of the Iron Throne. Fond of playing with his kittens (Ser Pounce) and eating honey cakes, he possesses none of the vicious cruelty of his brother Joffrey. Placed upon a barbed throne he does not understand, his kind, impressionable nature makes him a fragile pawn in the vicious struggles between his mother Cersei, Queen Margaery Tyrell, and the religious zealotry of the High Sparrow.
Background: Younger son of Queen Cersei and Ser Jaime Lannister, Tommen grew up bullied and overshadowed by his sadistic older brother Joffrey. During the Battle of the Blackwater, Cersei sat with Tommen upon the Iron Throne in the empty throne room, ready to administer essence of nightshade before Tywin's victorious entrance saved them. Following Joffrey's poisoning at the Purple Wedding, Tommen was crowned King of the Seven Kingdoms and married to the widowed Margaery Tyrell. Plunged into a bitter tug-of-war between his mother's paranoia and Margaery's affection, the young king was entirely overwhelmed by the machinations tearing King's Landing apart.
